name: Takebe Hikari
source:
"......Next time, would you like to play together?"

A third-year student at the school and the oldest student in the boarding house. But no matter how one looks at it, she appears to be younger than the others.

Even in the boarding house, for some reason, she stays a shut-in, spending her days absorbing in video games, the Internet, and so on.

She is the type to thoroughly sticks to anything that grabs her interest and does not hesitate to spend time on it without eating or sleeping. Recently, she has been doing a video game livestreaming, her streams which show only the flat-chested tank top, have become very popular due to the fact that her nipples are almost visible yet still invisible.

Her alter-ego is the [i]ninja[/i] "Kagiroi" and there seems to be a big secret about her true identity, but she is not bothered by it at all and always doing things her own pace.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/hero/character/hikari.html]official website[/url]]
